description: Candidate domains for selection and schema design. Entries are not installable module definitions.

modules.name: Groceries
modules.description: Shopping lists, items, quantities, units, stores, substitutions, and purchased state.
modules.example: We need milk, oats, and two lemons.

modules.name: Pantry
modules.description: Food on hand, quantities, storage locations, expiry dates, and stock changes.
modules.example: We have three cans of chickpeas in the cupboard.

modules.name: Recipes
modules.description: Ingredients, quantities, servings, preparation steps, and personal variations.
modules.example: Save this lentil soup recipe; it serves four.

modules.name: Meal Plans
modules.description: Meals planned for dates, eaters, portions, and recipe references.
modules.example: Let's have the lentil soup on Tuesday.

modules.name: Food Diary
modules.description: Meals actually eaten, portions, times, and observations.
modules.example: I had oatmeal and a banana for breakfast.

modules.name: Shopping Wishlists
modules.description: Desired products, variants, quantity, priority, budget, and retailer links.
modules.example: I'm looking for a blue rain jacket in size medium.

modules.name: Purchases
modules.description: Consumer orders and items, merchant, cost, delivery progress, and personal return/refund tracking.
modules.example: The headphones I ordered are due Friday.

modules.name: Gifts
modules.description: Recipients, occasions, gift ideas, budget, and purchase/wrapping/giving state.
modules.example: A cookbook could be a good birthday gift for Sam.

modules.name: Stock Watchlists
modules.description: Instruments being watched, reasons, user-stated targets, and research references.
modules.example: Add NVDA to my watchlist.

modules.name: Investment Holdings
modules.description: Accounts, owned positions, lots, quantities, acquisition costs, and investment transactions.
modules.example: I bought ten shares of NVDA.

modules.name: Transactions
modules.description: Personal income, expenses, transfers, amounts, currencies, dates, and counterparties.
modules.example: I spent £42 on groceries today.

modules.name: Budgets
modules.description: Period-based spending plans, category allocations, and planned limits.
modules.example: Keep my dining-out budget at £150 this month.

modules.name: Bills
modules.description: Amounts owed, payees, due dates, recurrence, and payment state.
modules.example: My electricity bill is due on the 20th.

modules.name: Subscriptions
modules.description: Services, plans, recurring charges, trials, renewal dates, and cancellation state.
modules.example: My music subscription renews monthly.

modules.name: Debts and Loans
modules.description: Money borrowed or lent, counterparties, agreed terms, balances, and repayments.
modules.example: I lent Alex £40 yesterday.

modules.name: Shared Expenses
modules.description: Participants, shared costs, allocation shares, and settlements.
modules.example: Split the £60 dinner equally between the three of us.

modules.name: Receipts
modules.description: Structured purchase evidence: merchant, date, line items, totals, and source-file references.
modules.example: Here is the receipt from yesterday's grocery trip.

modules.name: Belongings
modules.description: Owned physical items, serial/model details, locations, acquisition records, and manuals.
modules.example: My washing machine's serial number is ABC123.

modules.name: Warranties
modules.description: Coverage terms, covered items, dates, providers, claim references, and evidence.
modules.example: The washing machine has a three-year warranty.

modules.name: Maintenance
modules.description: Service plans, repairs, inspections, replaced parts, costs, and history linked to belongings or vehicles.
modules.example: I replaced the air filter today.

modules.name: Housing
modules.description: Homes, address history, occupancy, leases, rent/deposit details, and document references.
modules.example: My lease ends on August 31.

modules.name: Utilities
modules.description: Household service accounts, meters, readings, usage, and bill references.
modules.example: The water meter reads 1842 today.

modules.name: Plants
modules.description: Plants, locations, care needs, watering/repotting history, and observations.
modules.example: I repotted the monstera this morning.

modules.name: Pet Care
modules.description: Pets, care routines, vet visits, and health-document references.
modules.example: Luna has a vet appointment next Tuesday.

modules.name: Vehicles
modules.description: Cars/bikes, identifiers, mileage, fuel or charging logs, and document/service references.
modules.example: The car odometer is at 42,000 miles.

modules.name: Health Profile
modules.description: Explicitly supplied conditions, allergies, relevant history, and emergency information with provenance.
modules.example: I have a peanut allergy.

modules.name: Medical Records
modules.description: Visit documents, test reports, immunizations, clinician details, and source evidence.
modules.example: Save the lab report I received today.

modules.name: Medications
modules.description: Medication and prescription details, supplied regimens, dose logs, and changes.
modules.example: My prescribed dose changed yesterday.

modules.name: Symptoms
modules.description: User-reported symptom episodes, onset, duration, severity, and context.
modules.example: The headache started after lunch.

modules.name: Measurements
modules.description: Personal measurements with values, units, timestamps, and measurement sources.
modules.example: Log today's weight measurement.

modules.name: Workouts
modules.description: Exercise sessions, routines, sets/reps, distance, duration, and performance.
modules.example: I ran five kilometres this morning.

modules.name: Sleep
modules.description: Sleep sessions, bedtime/wake times, interruptions, and reported quality.
modules.example: I slept from 11 pm until 7 am.

modules.name: Mood
modules.description: Explicitly reported mood, energy, stress, and contextual observations.
modules.example: I'm feeling calm but low on energy today.

modules.name: Cycle Tracking
modules.description: User-reported menstrual cycles, dates, symptoms, and related observations.
modules.example: My period started today.

modules.name: Trips
modules.description: Destinations, travellers, dates, itinerary items, and links to reservations and resources.
modules.example: We're planning a week in Lisbon in June.

modules.name: Reservations
modules.description: Personal flight, rail, lodging, rental, and activity confirmations and changes.
modules.example: My hotel check-in is Friday at 3 pm.

modules.name: Packing
modules.description: Packing lists with items, quantities, travellers, bags, and packed state.
modules.example: Put two spare shirts in my carry-on list.

modules.name: Routes
modules.description: Planned routes or recorded tracks, waypoints, travel mode, and relevant geometry.
modules.example: Save the walking route from the station to the hotel.

modules.name: Cards and Passes
modules.description: Membership/loyalty cards and personal access/transit passes, identifiers, validity, and issuer references.
modules.example: Save my library card number.

modules.name: Places
modules.description: Saved locations, addresses, coordinates, and personal annotations.
modules.example: Save this cafe as a place I'd like to visit.

modules.name: Books
modules.description: Books/editions, reading state, progress, highlights, and personal reviews.
modules.example: I finished reading Dune yesterday.

modules.name: Movies and TV
modules.description: Films/series, watch intentions, episode progress, viewing history, and ratings.
modules.example: I finished season two, episode five.

modules.name: Music
modules.description: Artists/albums/tracks, music-library references, favourites, and listening history.
modules.example: I want to remember this album.

modules.name: Podcasts
modules.description: Shows, followed feeds, episodes, queues, and playback progress.
modules.example: I stopped this episode at 18 minutes.

modules.name: Games
modules.description: Owned/wanted games, platforms, play sessions, progress, and personal notes.
modules.example: I finished the main story in that game.

modules.name: Learning Plans
modules.description: Learning objectives, resources/courses, planned study, and progress evidence.
modules.example: I want to learn conversational Spanish before the trip.

modules.name: Flashcards
modules.description: Study cards, decks or grouping references, and private review state/history.
modules.example: Make a flashcard for this Spanish word.

modules.name: Contacts
modules.description: Address-book entries, communication details, and private information supplied about contacts.
modules.example: Alex's new phone number is in this message.

modules.name: Relationships
modules.description: Explicit social connections, follows, requests/acceptances, blocks, and mutes.
modules.example: I want to follow this person's public updates.

modules.name: Conversations
modules.description: Human/AI conversation records, messages, participants, and source references.
modules.example: Keep the conversation about the kitchen renovation.

modules.name: Events
modules.description: Scheduled activities, recurrence, participants, location links, and native alert preferences.
modules.example: Dinner with Alex is Friday at seven.

modules.name: Personal Projects
modules.description: A project's purpose, outcomes, milestones, and links to tasks/resources.
modules.example: I'm restoring an old bicycle this summer.

modules.name: Goals
modules.description: Explicit personal targets, measures, deadlines, and progress observations.
modules.example: I want to complete a ten-kilometre run by September.

modules.name: Habits
modules.description: Repeated routines, schedules/targets, and actual check-ins.
modules.example: I want to walk every morning.

modules.name: Identity Documents
modules.description: Structured ID/passport/licence fields, scan references, extraction provenance, and reviewed corrections.
modules.example: Extract the fields from this ID card.

modules.name: Credentials
modules.description: Issuer-secured credential artifacts, local verification observations, and approved presentation history.
modules.example: Store the credential issued to my DID.

modules.name: Profiles
modules.description: The user's self-authored display identity, biography, images, and links.
modules.example: Update my public bio to this text.

modules.name: Preferences
modules.description: Explicit locale, accessibility, appearance, communication, and selected domain preferences.
modules.example: I prefer metric units and a 24-hour clock.

modules.name: Devices
modules.description: Personal device identity, configuration metadata, service history, and ownership/account references.
modules.example: I replaced my old laptop with this one.

modules.name: Online Accounts
modules.description: Service accounts, usernames, linked identities, plan/status metadata, and recovery references.
modules.example: My username on that service is riverbird.

modules.name: Insurance
modules.description: Personal policies, providers, covered subjects, supplied coverage details, dates, and claim/document references.
modules.example: My home insurance renews in March.

modules.name: Notes
modules.description: Personal writing, drafts, journal entries, and research notes.
modules.example: Save this thought for later.

modules.name: Files
modules.description: File identity, metadata, content, and independently managed attachments.
modules.example: Keep this PDF with my other documents.

modules.name: Bookmarks
modules.description: Saved web/DID-relative references, annotations, folders, and ordered entries.
modules.example: Bookmark this DWN record for later.

modules.name: Tasks
modules.description: Actions, deadlines, completion state, and native alert/checklist data.
modules.example: I need to call the dentist tomorrow.

modules.name: Time Entries
modules.description: Actual time spent on activities, with durations and project/task references.
modules.example: I spent two hours working on the bicycle.
